SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM msg_message WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = FALSE) AS "messageTotal",
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM msg_message WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = FALSE AND read_status = 0) AS "messageUnread",
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM msg_message WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = FALSE AND DATE(created_at) = CURRENT_DATE) AS "messageToday",
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM msg_template WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = FALSE) AS "templateTotal",
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM msg_template WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = FALSE AND is_enabled = TRUE) AS "templateEnabled",
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM msg_todo WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = FALSE) AS "todoTotal",
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM msg_todo WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = FALSE AND process_status = 0) AS "todoPending",
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM msg_todo WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = FALSE AND process_status = 1 AND DATE(completed_at) = CURRENT_DATE) AS "todoDoneToday",
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM msg_push_config WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = FALSE) AS "pushConfigTotal",
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM msg_push_config WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = FALSE AND is_enabled = TRUE) AS "pushConfigEnabled",
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM msg_alert_rule WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = FALSE) AS "alertRuleTotal",
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM msg_alert_rule WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = FALSE AND is_enabled = TRUE) AS "alertRuleEnabled",
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM msg_doc_comment WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = FALSE) AS "docCommentTotal",
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM msg_doc_comment WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = FALSE AND DATE(created_at) = CURRENT_DATE) AS "docCommentToday",
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM msg_discussion WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = FALSE) AS "discussionTotal",
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM msg_discussion_reply WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = FALSE) AS "discussionReplyTotal",
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM msg_type WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = FALSE) AS "msgTypeTotal",
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM msg_type WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = FALSE AND is_enabled = TRUE) AS "msgTypeEnabled"

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', created_at) AS "period", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM msg_message WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = FALSE AND created_at BETWEEN #{startDate}::TIMESTAMP AND #{endDate}::TIMESTAMP GROUP BY "period" ORDER BY "period"

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', created_at) AS "period", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM msg_todo WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = FALSE AND created_at BETWEEN #{startDate}::TIMESTAMP AND #{endDate}::TIMESTAMP GROUP BY "period" ORDER BY "period"
SELECT process_status AS "processStatus", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM msg_todo WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = FALSE GROUP BY process_status

SELECT t.type_name AS "typeName", COUNT(m.id) AS "count" FROM msg_message m INNER JOIN msg_type t ON m.msg_type_id = t.id AND t.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.is_deleted = FALSE GROUP BY t.type_name ORDER BY "count" DESC
SELECT push_channel AS "pushChannel", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM msg_push_config WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = FALSE GROUP BY push_channel ORDER BY "count" DESC

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', created_at) AS "period", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM msg_message WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = FALSE AND source_type = 'ALERT' AND created_at BETWEEN #{startDate}::TIMESTAMP AND #{endDate}::TIMESTAMP GROUP BY "period" ORDER BY "period"

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', created_at) AS "period", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM msg_doc_comment WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = FALSE AND created_at BETWEEN #{startDate}::TIMESTAMP AND #{endDate}::TIMESTAMP GROUP BY "period" ORDER BY "period"
